goals.objective: Implement the Prior Cognitive Art publication-readiness plan end to end: verify and add claim-relevant scholarship, remove draft-gap manuscript language, add three deterministic conceptual figures for an 18-figure contract, update claim ledger/docs/TODO/readiness report, regenerate outputs, render PDF through the template pipeline, prove no draft/template-token residue remains, perform visual QA, and finish with reviewer approval. Constraints: conceptual manuscript only, no simulations or empirical performance numbers, preserve unrelated worktree changes, no commit/push unless separately requested.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/data happy path: from project root run uv scripts and tests, from template root render the PDF, then verify exact 18-figure parity and fresh publication-readiness/TODO outputs. PASS iff all commands exit 0 and parity/report checks pass.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Post-split project generation and render passed: optimization_analysis-after-split, build_dashboard-after-split, generate_api_docs-after-split, z_generate_manuscript_variables-after-split, pytest 73 passed, link-projects dry-run clean, template render-after-split produced 1.98 MB combined PDF with 18/18 figure references. Authoritative evidence file: evidence/C001-happy-path.log. Supporting logs: evidence/pytest-after-split.log, evidence/render-pdf-after-split.log, evidence/final-contract-closure-after-split.log.

successCriteria.scenario: publication-surface edge/adversarial path: scan source and rendered manuscript/PDF text for draft-gap phrases and unresolved template tokens, and verify scholarship claims are backed by accepted source decisions plus claim-ledger rows. PASS iff the scan has zero forbidden matches and ledger/audit checks pass.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Post-split surface/adversarial scans passed: broad source/rendered/PDF draft/future-work scans clean, rendered token scans clean, publication-surface stale-count scan clean, 40 BibTeX entries closed to 40 cited keys, scholarship audit and claim ledger updated. Authoritative evidence file: evidence/C002-surface-scan.log. Supporting logs: evidence/broad-draft-marker-scan-after-split.log, evidence/output-token-scan-after-split.log, evidence/pdf-text-scan-after-split.log, evidence/publication-surface-stale-phrase-scan-after-split.log, evidence/final-contract-closure-after-split.log.

successCriteria.scenario: regression and visual surface: inspect all 18 regenerated PNG figures plus representative PDF pages for readability and confirm existing dashboard/API-doc output surfaces still generate. PASS iff visual QA artifact records no clipping/blank figures and dashboard/API docs regenerate.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Post-split regression, manual QA, cleanup, and slop/overfit coverage passed: exact 18 PNG/18 SVG parity, qpdf clean after split, all figures and representative PDF pages inspected after split, expected visual-regression evidence file present, code-review/slop report present, no-residue tests and pure-LOC ceiling test pass, figure renderer split into <=250 pure-LOC modules. Authoritative evidence file: evidence/C003-visual-regression.md. Supporting files: evidence/figure-contact-sheet-after-split.png, evidence/pdf-page-contact-sheet-after-split.png, evidence/code-review-slop-report-after-split.md, evidence/figure-module-size-after-split.log.
